item.title: An 'Olive Garden' N64 Game That Never Existed Remembered Fondly By Gamers
item.description: Olive Garden N64 refers to memes about a fictional Nintendo 64 video game based on the Italian restaurant Olive Garden. The earliest known meme about an Olive Garden video game was posted in May 2020. Memes, including mockups of an Olive Garden cartridge and posts pretending the game is real, became increasingly popular over the next few years.

item.title: 'Eminem Throwing Things' Meme Sparks New Variation With Rose Redraws On Twitter
item.description: Eminem Throwing Rose Redraws refers to a screenshot showing the Eminem Throwing Things meme (also known as Woe, Plague Be Upon Ye) throwing a rose, and beside it an image of a guy who was shocked after the rose flew to him as if it was from Eminem's POV. The image gained virality in early February 2026 as artists on Twitter / X used it as a redraw format to draw fan art of other characters doing the same thing.

item.title: Chads Are 'Always Emerging From Somewhere' To Mog You In This Viral Looksmaxxing Meme
item.description: Always Emerging From Somewhere is a looksmaxxing related meme trend where footage of someone minding their business and believing themselves safe from being mogged is shown, followed by footage of someone deemed a "Chad" emerging, often from the ocean, to mog them. The meme was popularized on TikTok through February 2026 and often utilizes a clip of actor Aaron Taylor-Johnson from an Armani ad swimming and emerging from the ocean as a representation of a Chad.

item.title: Who Is TheBurntPeanut? The Twitch Streamer's Meteoric Rise Explained
item.description: TheBurntPeanut is a Twitch streamer and YouTube VTuber who streams first-person shooter games, including ARC Raiders and Escape from Tarkov. He uses a 3D avatar depicting a roasted peanut overlaid with his real eyes and mouth. TheBurntPeanut saw a meteoric rise in followers, dubbed "Bungulators," in 2025.
